title: obs-control-plane-tolerations
description:
restreamer + cloudflared-obs have been Pending 26d.
Root cause: k8s/charts/obs/restreamer.yaml and k8s/charts/obs/cloudflared.yaml pin to macintel01 (intentional - only node on the OBS LAN, comments explain why) and tolerate node.kubernetes.io/unschedulable + node.cilium.io/agent-not-ready, but macintel01 now also carries the node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane taint which they do not tolerate.
Add to BOTH files' tolerations lists: `- key: node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane` with `operator: Exists`, preserving existing tolerations and the targeted-toleration comment style (extend comments, don't delete).
Do NOT apply to the cluster.
ACCEPTANCE: Rendered/manifest tolerations on both workloads include node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane Exists; existing tolerations untouched; comments preserved in same style. Diff committed; evidence in tk comment.
